summary: Tested the full Segnalatori feature on both backend and frontend. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests pass (options, create and validation, RBAC scope for segnalatore/BO/admin, esito OK/KO/NR, OK without sotto esiti returns 400, sotto esiti cleared on KO, history, real Aruba Drive upload and download, empty file returns 400, 404s, admin creates a segnalatore user). Frontend: admin create and edit of a Segnalatore user (Commesse Autorizzate, then per-commessa servizi) works; segnalatore login shows only the 'Segnalatori' sidebar item and the page loads directly; Fastweb/TLS are preselected; create with an attachment shows the row with 'Da lavorare' and doc count 1; the segnalatore detail has no esito-form; adding files from the detail and downloading them work. BO: esito-form, OK shows 6 sotto-esito checkboxes, save stays disabled until one is checked, multi-select save shows the badge with sotto esiti, KO/NR hide and clear sotto esiti, history lists all entries, row badge updates. Search, esito and commessa filters all work. No page errors. The mobile create dialog renders well.

minor.issue: No DELETE endpoint for documents or segnalazioni, so test files stay on Aruba Drive (Fastweb/Segnalazioni folder). Wrong uploads cannot be removed.
telefono is only checked for min_length=5. Any characters are accepted (no phone format validation).

ui_bugs.issue: Right after 'Salva esito', the first Escape only closes the toast (Radix layer stack) and a second Escape closes the dialog. Low priority.

issues: The '1. SELEZIONA COMMESSA' selector at the bottom of the sidebar is shown to segnalatore users. It has no effect on the Segnalatori page and is confusing; hide it for this role.
The 'Gestione Entità' (Solo Clienti) field is shown for segnalatore but is irrelevant.
Create/edit user modal fields have no data-testid attributes (existing issue).

action_items: Optional: hide the sidebar 'Seleziona Commessa' selector and the 'Gestione Entità' field for the segnalatore role
Optional: add delete for segnalazione documents (and Aruba file) for admin/BO
Add segnalatore_test and bo_segn_test credentials to /app/memory/test_credentials.md (currently missing)
Segnalatore users created from the UI get password_change_required=True: confirm this is intended for the first login
critical_code_review_comments: Segnalazioni.jsx load() and the options fetch have no try/catch: on an API error (e.g. 403 for a non-allowed role) loading stays true and the promise rejection is unhandled. Add error toast/state.
SegnalazioneDetailDialog load() has no error handling: a 404 leaves the dialog stuck on 'Caricamento...'.
EsitoForm keeps the previous nota_esito when switching esito (prefilled from the last esito). This may be intended, but each history entry then repeats the old nota.
The list endpoint returns the full documents array per row only to count docs. Consider a projection to a count for large lists.
